topic: Assessment of damage and estimation of loads, preparation of repair scheme.
syllabus_extract: Assessment of damage and estimation of loads, preparation of repair scheme. Material specification, special tools required for carrying out repairs
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Demonstration of damage assessment techniques, load estimation calculations, and repair scheme preparation using standard tools and material specifications.
intro_questions: What are the primary structural elements of an aircraft?
How is damage classified in aircraft structures?
Why is load estimation critical before initiating repairs?

List three special tools required for aircraft structural repairs.
Describe the steps involved in preparing a repair scheme.
